image_description: A close-up, side-profile photograph of an African crocodile's head and upper neck. The image highlights the textured, armored skin (scutes), the V-shaped snout, and a row of interlocking conical teeth visible along the jawline. The eye is visible with a reptilian appearance, and the background is a blurred natural environment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout tapers distinctly towards the nostrils, forming the characteristic V-shape of a crocodile rather than the U-shape of an alligator.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple sharp, conical teeth are clearly visible protruding from the jawline, fitting the description of interlocking dentition.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is located on the top ridge of the skull (dorsal positioning). While the pupil shape is hard to resolve at this resolution, the placement and general morphology are correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nostril opening is clearly visible at the very end of the snout structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight crop of the head; the full length of the body is not visible to verify elongation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The skin texture on the head and visible neck area shows distinct, rough, bony plates consistent with osteoderms/scutes.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The coloration is a mix of earthy browns and greys, and the texture is visibly rough and granular.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside (ventral surface) of the crocodile is not visible in this profile shot.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs or feet are visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is completely outside the frame.

alignment_reasoning: All testable checkpoints regarding the head, snout shape, teeth, and skin texture are perfectly met. The image is a high-fidelity representation of the target class. Non-testable checkpoints (body length, limbs, tail) are excluded due to framing, but no contradictions exist.
artifact_reasoning: No AI-generation artifacts detected. The image exhibits natural depth of field blur, realistic skin micro-texture, and correct anatomical proportions for a crocodile head. Lighting and shadows are physically consistent.
